title: Died after a week of use
text: Died after a week of use. Was great at first but now it will not turn on no matter what I do.  Orange light turns on but nothing else happens.  Not happy.

product_metadata.title: GiveBest Space Heater for Indoor Use, Upgraded 1500W Fast Heating Electric Ceramic Heater with 4 Modes, Timer, Overheating & Tip-Over Protection, ETL Listed, Small Portable Heater for Room
features: Safety First: With ETL test, this room heater will bring your safe care to families and pets by automatic overheat protection, tip-over shut down when tilted and 24H unattended auto off

Multifunctional Mode: 1500W, 750W and ECO(economical) heating levels brings you flexible setting, specially the ECO mode will enable your room a optimal temperature and save extra energy, at the same time this portable space heater can be used as a portable fan

Quiet and Bright Display: Low noise space heater for bedroom, home study, great performance while sleeping, reading and working, the high definition digital display supports clear reading in dark environmen
Efficient and Reliable: 1 second immediate heating to drive out the cold, inbuilt PTC heating elements enhances stable heating circulation of this space heaters for indoor use

Occasions: With large carry handle, lightweight and small body, it make this electric heater easy to be placed to any indoor or outdoor position. No space occupation. It must be a considerate gift for friends and family in winter or Christmas
description: A compact and efficient desktop heater, you deserve it! SPECIFICATIONS: 1. Four Modes Setting 1500W high mode, 750W low mode, ECO mode for auto adjustment according to your setting, fan mode only supplies cool wind. 2. Tip-over Protection The tip-over switch is located at the bottom of the ceramic space heater, it will shut off the unit when tilted or tripped over unintentionally. 3. Overheat Protection The Automatic overheat system will shut the unit off when the parts of the heater overheat. If this occurs, please turn the heater off, unplug it, and inspect and remove any objects on or adjacent to the heater that may cause high temperature. Wait 10 to 20 minutes for the unit to cool down the plug it back in and resume the normal operation. 4. 24H Unattended Auto Off When this indoor heater running over 24H without any operation(or unattended), it will be auto off. WARNINGS: 1. Always plug heater directly into a wall outlet/receptacle. 2. Never use with an extension cord. 3. DO NOT plug heater into any other cord connected device, such as a power strip, surge protector, multiple outlet adapter, cord reel or outlet-type air freshener. 4. Using such devices may cause a fire hazard. 5. Extreme caution is necessary when this heater fan is used by or near children, pets or patients. 6.Unplug the power cord before servicing or moving the mini heater. 7.DO NOT insert foreign objects/body parts into any of the ventilation or exhaust opening as it may cause an electric shock, fire, or damage to the heater or user. 8.DO NOT block or tamper with the heater in any manner while operating. 9.DO NOT block air intakes or exhaust in any manner. 10.Maintain a minimum distance of 3 feet from other objectives for proper positioning and working of the heater. PACKAGE: 1 x Portable electric space heater 1 x User’s manual Try this dorm heater!
